name: "More nutrition" expandable micronutrient panel
gap: Only the four fixed micros (fibre, sugar, saturated fat, sodium) against constant reference values rather than nutrient targets scaled from the profile and TDEE, and no per-row partial markers.

name: Nutrition Trends tab (range toggle + three charts)
gap: Range toggle, target line, weight line and a stats block are there, but the daily-averages grid (protein, carbs, fat, fibre, sodium means) is missing and the weight line plots raw weigh-ins rather than an EMA trend.

name: Recipe log sheet (bottom sheet: servings, meal slot, log)
Recipe builder (create a user recipe)
gap: Name, servings, food-table chips, free-text lines and live totals are there, but there is no ingredient search over saved foods, no per-ingredient grams, no raw/cooked yield conversion and no manual per-100 g ingredient.

name: Quick-log food chip (tap to log, long-press to favourite)
Live camera barcode scanning (BarcodeDetector, ZXing fallback)
gap: Source says why: "Reading a barcode off the camera needs a decoder this build does not carry, so it is not pretending to have one. The digits printed under the bars are the same barcode: type them in." (fuel.html:3487).

name: Barcode product found — portion, meal, log
gap: Servings, live macro tiles, slot picker and Log all work, but the portion is servings-only (no grams field, no "1 serving (Ng)" shortcut) and the resolved product is never saved locally, so the same code has to be looked up again next time.

name: Barcode not found — manual label entry
gap: The not-found branch hands off to the manual form, but the barcode is dropped on the way, so the typed label is not stored against the GTIN and the next scan of that code fails the same way.

name: Fuel display settings card (hide numbers, dashboard framing)
gap: "Show calorie numbers" survives and Fuel honours it, but the Left/Eaten dashboard framing was cut: "Fuel display preferences (hide calories, Left/Eaten). Settings for a screen belong on that screen" (settings.html:97).

name: Privacy disclosure card
gap: Source says why: "The privacy disclosure block. Legal text with a +/- affordance is not a control; it configures nothing." (settings.html:99).

name: Adaptive TDEE weekly check-in card
gap: The card shows the estimate, its working and Use/Keep, but there is no weekly cadence: nothing writes a tdeeHistory entry, there is no freshness rule, and "Keep mine" is session-only so the card is back on the next load.

name: Nutrition CSV / JSON export and full-account backup/restore
gap: Meal CSV, full JSON backup and a real file-picker restore all work; the CSV carries no weight-log table and the restore has no merge/overwrite choice or timestamp-skip.

name: Natural-language food text parsing (AI) → local food matching
gap: A local alias-and-unit parser replaces the model, so anything outside the eight-row food table comes back as unmatched rather than resolved.

name: AI meal-item normalisation
gap: There is no model response to normalise: the photo path renders a fixed worked example and says so.

name: Pantry depletion on logging + expiry heuristics
gap: Depletion, auto-add to the shopping list and restore-on-delete all work, but there are no expiry/use-soon heuristics and no best-price or last-price helpers anywhere in the build.

name: Weight-trend and intake statistics helpers
gap: A per-week rate over a stretched (>=5 day) span and an average-intake window exist, but there is no EMA trend series and no trend-on-or-before lookup, so every chart plots raw weigh-ins.

name: Fuel micro-helpers (slots, favourites, training day, water goal)
gap: slotForNow, nextEmptySlot, waterGoal (35 ml/kg rounded to 50), favourites and a real frequency tally are all there; nothing in Fuel knows whether today is a training day.

name: Fuel tab shell / header
gap: Date, title and Profile are in the header, but the Shop action was dropped from it ("Two text buttons side by side in a header have no gap between their hit areas", fuel.html:1396) and now hides behind the More chip.

name: Fuel sub-tab navigation (Log / Meals toggle + pill row)
gap: The Log/Meals segmented control and the scrolling pill row are replaced by one chip row that opens sheets, and the chosen view is not remembered between visits.

name: Calorie / macro summary card (MacroRing + macro bars)
MacroRing SVG progress ring
gap: Source says why: "BARS, NOT A RING, and that is a decision rather than an omission... This screen has four quantities that matter at once and four concentric rings is a chart nobody can read a number off" (fuel.html:1708).

name: Fuel Profile Setup — open / back / save
Fuel Profile — body weight input + unit toggle
gap: The weight field reads and writes in whatever unit LKUnits is on, but the form carries no lbs/kg toggle of its own - the unit is changed in Settings.

name: Fuel Profile — height input (ft/in or cm)
gap: One centimetres field with a ft/in readout under it; there is no ft/cm toggle and no feet-plus-inches entry.

name: Fuel Profile — goal picker (Cut / Maintain / Bulk)
Fuel Profile — Auto vs Custom macros
gap: The Auto/Mine toggle is there and Auto recomputes live, but "Mine" has no fields on this sheet: it defers to the separate Daily targets sheet, so custom macros cannot be set where they are chosen.

name: Fuel Profile — dietary preferences chips
gap: Preferences are one free-text field rather than six toggleable chips, and nothing is filtered by them - the sheet says so.

name: Fuel Profile — allergies and fridge/pantry
gap: Allergies survives as free text; the fridge/pantry staples box is gone, and nothing on this sheet reaches the pantry screen that replaced it.

name: Smart Nutrition suggestion card
gap: A local picker over the eight-row food table stands in for the model, so a suggestion can only ever be one of eight foods, and the card cannot be dismissed.

name: Fuel log data model + per-day totals
Adaptive TDEE application on tab mount
gap: The 70/30 blend and the +/-150 clamp are both there, but nothing applies on mount and no history is written, so there is no weekly cadence and every move is a manual tap.

name: Refeed day prompt and active banner
gap: Trigger, offer, accepted banner and the stored refeed day all work; "Not today" is session-only, with no stored dismissal or cool-off, so the card returns on the next load.

name: Weight log card + TDEE report card (hosted here)
Shopping & Budget entry point
gap: It is there and it navigates, but the entry point is the unlabelled "More" chip at the end of a chip row rather than anything that says Shop.

name: Meal plan — today's plan card
gap: Today is expanded by default inside the Plan sheet with a per-meal Log and a whole-day Log, but it is not a card on the main Fuel view and no ingredient line is shown under each meal.

name: Meal plan — AI meal swap (alternatives sheet)
gap: Source says why: "NOT BUILT, deliberately: the swap-by-AI path. In the shipped app a failed swap invented four meals and wrote them into the saved plan as though a model had returned them (audit H2). Swapping here picks from your own recipes and often-logged meals, which cannot fabricate anything." (fuel.html:860).

name: Meal plan — generate new plan form
gap: Days, meals-a-day, a leave-out field and a preview are all there, but the generator is a local table picker: no diet or budget preferences, and with eight foods a three-meal week can land hundreds of kcal short (the sheet says so).

name: Meal plan — JSON repair and shopping list rebuild
gap: Nothing here generates JSON, so there is nothing to repair; the shopping list is rebuilt from the plan's own foods instead.

name: Meal plan — saved plans list (activate / star / delete)
Natural-language meal estimate ("ESTIMATE MACROS", List tab)
gap: The sentence is parsed locally against the eight-row table instead of being sent to the model, so anything the table has never heard of is reported unmatched rather than estimated.

name: Today's Diary (show/hide, per-meal grouping)
gap: The day is grouped by slot with per-slot P/C/F and kcal footers, but there is no show/hide control on the diary.

name: Food text search (multi-source fan-out)
gap: Search covers the built-in table and your own recipes only; USDA, FatSecret and Open Food Facts all need the network, and saved My Store foods are not in the result set at all.

name: Food detail card: grams + serving-size quick chips
My Store (saved foods)
gap: Saving a food at your own gram weight, listing, logging and removing all work, but the store lives inside the Meals sheet: no chips in the search view, no screen of its own, and dedupe is by food-plus-grams rather than by name.

name: USDA API key setup
gap: There is no remote food search, so there is no key to set and no screen to set it on.

name: Barcode hand-off from the search box
AI photo/description meal analysis
gap: The photo stays on the device and the items shown are a fixed worked example, captioned as such: reading a plate needs a model behind a server.

name: Photo result card: Log Meal / Re-estimate
Recipes: For You / From Pantry tab switch
Static "Classic Recipes" library
gap: Three recipes rather than six, and no dietary or goal filtering - preferences are printed as a note beside the list instead.

name: RCard: Add to shop (ingredients → shopping list)
gap: Missing ingredients go on the list and anything already in the cupboard or on the list is skipped, but the line is added verbatim: no quantity or unit is parsed and nothing merges into an existing row.

name: AI "Meal ideas" (4 meals from profile)
gap: No model call and no control for it; the local stand-ins are the suggestion card and the For You ordering, which can only ever offer the eight built-in foods and three recipes.

name: AI "Plan my day" (4 meals with slots)
gap: No model call; the deterministic week builder under Plan > Build a different week stands in, and it fills slots from the food table rather than composing meals.

name: Pantry-based recipe generation
gap: "From the pantry" ranks the built-in recipes by how much of each is already in the cupboard; nothing generates a recipe from what you have.

name: Coach recipes (read-only, from a coach)
gap: lk_coachRecipes is not read anywhere in the build and there is no coach-authored recipe surface, so nothing a coach writes can reach Fuel.

name: Shopping-list & store helper layer (in range, not a Fuel-entry UI)
gap: List read/write, add, remove, tick, categorise and export are all there, but there is no ingredient parser (quantity and unit) and the store URL builder is one generic /search?q= pattern instead of the thirteen retailer-specific ones.

name: Shop & Budget hub shell (4 sub-tabs + status pills)
Add item — typeahead over the local FOODS table
Store product search (`/store-search`)
gap: The typeahead is the local 111-row food table only: per-store product names and prices need the /store-search call, so no result ever carries a store chip or a price.

name: Add item to the list (with duplicate merge dialog)
Check off / uncheck a list item
Category grouping of the shopping list
Per-item store deep links
gap: The per-store search works, but it lives inside the item's sheet rather than as chips under each row, so reaching one is two taps instead of one.

name: "Shop at…" — open the whole list at one store
Pantry — mark out of stock / restocked
Pantry — category grouping and All/Staples filter
Staples — restock interval suggestion from purchase history
Staples — auto-add due items to the shopping list
Receipt → pantry population
gap: A typed purchase does populate the pantry and restart a staple's clock, but nothing reads the items off a receipt photo: that needs a parser behind a server, which the card says the build has not got.

name: Receipt scan (camera or library) → `/parse-receipt`
gap: Camera and library inputs are real and the photo is kept beside the form, but nothing parses it: "Reading the lines off a photo needs a server, and this build has none, so nothing is read for you" (shopping.html:741).

name: Confirm receipt → history + pantry
gap: A typed purchase lands in history (stamped "receipt" while a photo is open) and in the pantry, but there is no parsed-item confirm list, no per-item edit and no store select seeded from the parse.

name: Import checked shopping-list items as a pending purchase — DEAD
gap: Not built - it was dead in v6 too; pendingItems is written as an empty array and read by nothing.

name: Smart Savings — AI cheaper swaps (bare-root AI call)
gap: "Cheaper swaps" compares this week's shop against prices already in your own history and says so; a cheaper product at a shop you have never used needs the model.

name: Price comparison across stores (bare-root AI call)
gap: "What you have paid" reports your own prices per shop, cheapest first, and names the shops it has nothing for; live or modelled prices need the server.

name: Purchase history with week / month / all / receipts filters
MealPlannerTab — dead duplicate meal planner
gap: Not carried over: the redesign has one meal planner, in Fuel's Plan sheet, and the v6 component was a dead duplicate, so nothing a user could reach is lost.

name: Supplement push notifications
gap: Source says why: "A card on Home, not a push notification. Push needs a server and a permission this build does not ask for." (fuel.html:2489) - the due windows and the Home card are the whole local half.

name: Add / edit a compound (within a cycle)
Compound preset database browser
gap: Search and category filter both work, but over twelve presets rather than v6's thirty-two, so most of the database a user would look for is not there.

name: AI cycle overview
gap: "Read the stack" builds a deterministic paragraph from this cycle's own half-lives and ancillaries after a fixed wait; it is not a model, it is not saved onto the cycle, and it cannot answer anything outside that template.

name: Cycle detail — today's doses
gap: Today's doses and the take buttons live on the Stack list, not inside the cycle, so an opened cycle has no dose control of its own, no not-scheduled-today rows and no per-compound streak.

name: Cycle detail — compound roster, AI overview, notes
